item.title: Weekly schedule of President António Costa
item.description: Weekly schedule of President António Costa, 2-8 November 2026.

item.title: Remarks by President António Costa at the press conference following the EU-Canada summit
item.description: President of the European Council António Costa presented the main results of the discussions of the leaders during the 21st EU-Canada summit held in Montreal on 29-30 October 2026.

item.title: Joint statement EU-Canada summit, 30 October 2026
item.description: The leaders of the European Union and Canada held their 21st EU-Canada summit in Montreal on 29-30 October 2026, and agreed on a joint statement.

item.title: Forward look: 2 - 15 November 2026
item.description: Overview of the main subjects to be discussed at meetings of the Council of the EU over the next two weeks and upcoming media events.

item.title: Remarks by President António Costa at the official dinner of the EU-Canada summit
item.description: On 29 October 2026, President António Costa delivered remarks at the official dinner of the 21st EU-Canada summit of 29-30 October 2026, in Montreal.

item.title: Closing remarks by President António Costa at the EU-Canada Business Forum
item.description: On 29 October 2026, President António Costa delivered closing remarks at the EU-Canada Business Forum, ahead of the 21st EU-Canada summit of 29-30 October 2026, in Montreal.

item.title: Speech by President António Costa at the Montreal Council on Foreign Relations
item.description: On 29 October 2026, President António Costa gave a speech to the Montreal Council on Foreign Relations (MCFR) ahead of the 21st EU-Canada summit taking place in Montreal on 29 and 30 October 2026.

item.title: European Peace Facility: Council adopts 4th bilateral assistance measure in support of Mauritania
item.description: The Council adopted the fourth bilateral assistance measure, worth €20 million, under the European Peace Facility (EPF) in support of the armed forces of Mauritania, which will help the country promote stability in the Sahel and safeguard its territorial integrity and sovereignty.

item.title: Council publishes 2025 international climate finance figures
item.description: In 2025, the EU and its 27 member states contributed €32.3 billion in climate finance from public sources and mobilised an additional amount of €9.3 billion of private finance to support developing countries to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions and adapt to the impacts of climate change.

item.title: Press statement by Eurogroup President Kyriakos Pierrakakis following the announcement of the President of the European Central Bank, Christine Lagarde, to step down on 7 February 2027
item.description: Eurogroup President, Kyriakos Pierrakakis, commented on the announcement of President of the European Central Bank, Christine Lagarde, to step down on 7 February 2027.

item.title: Statement by President António Costa on the forthcoming departure of Christine Lagarde from the European Central Bank
item.description: President of the European Council António Costa issued a statement on the announcement by Christine Lagarde of her forthcoming departure from the European Central Bank on 7 February 2027.

item.title: Media advisory - Accreditation for the EU-UK Summit on 20 November 2026
item.description: The EU-UK Summit will take place on 20 November 2026 in the Europa building in Brussels.

item.title: President Costa travels to Montreal for the EU-Canada Summit
item.description: The President of the European Council, António Costa, will travel to Montreal, Canada, for the 21st EU-Canada summit on 29 and 30 October. He will represent the EU together with the President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen. Canada will be represented by Prime Minister Mark Carney.

item.title: MFF 2028-2034: Council secures negotiating position for a strong and future-oriented common agricultural policy
item.description: The Council agrees its negotiating position on the regulation for the post-2027 common agricultural policy, aiming to support a more competitive, sustainable and resilient EU agriculture sector.

item.title: Baltic Sea: Council reaches agreement on fishing opportunities for 2027
item.description: Council agrees on Baltic Sea fisheries catch limits for 2027 for key fish stocks, namely herring, sprat, cod, salmon and plaice.

item.title: EU support for Ukraine: Council mobilises €4.9 billion under the European Peace Facility
item.description: Today the Council adopted a set of decisions mobilising funds for Ukraine under the European Peace Facility. These decisions will allow for the partial reimbursement of previously delivered military aid and provide additional financing for the EU Military Assistance Mission in Support of Ukraine.

item.title: One-year badge 2027 - accreditation is open
item.description: Information about accreditation requirements for the one-year badge (2027)

item.title: Media advisory - Accreditation for the European Council, 17 and 18 December 2026
item.description: The European Council will take place on 17 and 18 December 2026 in the Europa building in Brussels.

item.title: EU sanctions against ISIL/Da’esh and Al-Qaeda: Council renews regime until 2027
item.description: The Council extended restrictive measures against individuals and groups associated with ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaeda for a further year, until 31 October 2027.
